verdict.rationale: The only programmatic surface in the evidence is an undocumented, auth-gated first-party remote MCP server at mcp.reclaim.ai, which advertises read/write scopes. Nothing shows what it covers or that it matches the UI, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. missing for 10: a documented public REST API, an OpenAPI or reference spec, evidence of coverage across Tasks/Habits/Focus Time/Scheduling Links/Calendar Sync/settings, any vendor docs for the MCP server, and independent confirmation of UI parity.
